# Security Policy

## Supported versions

VibeBloat has no public release yet. Security fixes currently target the active build
branch and the next controlled release.

## Report a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting flow. Do not open a public issue for a
suspected vulnerability.

Include affected version or commit, reproduction steps, and impact. Never attach real
tokens, credentials, agent transcripts, or private repository content; use synthetic
fixtures instead.

Maintainers will validate the report, coordinate remediation, and publish disclosure
only after a fix is available.
